prompt: 현재 feature 브랜치를 최신 origin/main 위로 업데이트해줘. working tree는 clean이고 main에 새 커밋 3개가 있어.
expectations: It uses the fetched origin/main as the base.
It preserves linear history through rebase rather than a merge commit.
It confirms the resulting base relationship and summarizes incoming commits.
guards: Guards against syncing with a merge commit or onto the stale local origin/main without fetching.

prompt: main 최신화해줘. 그런데 아직 커밋하지 않은 src/cart.ts와 새 파일 notes.txt가 있어.
expectations: It identifies the dirty files before rewriting history.
It does not commit, stash, or discard them without authority.
It leaves the local state intact and reports why the update cannot safely complete.

prompt: pull main 해줘. fetch해보니 HEAD가 이미 origin/main을 포함하고 있어.
expectations: It fetches or otherwise verifies current remote truth.
It performs no unnecessary history rewrite.
It reports the up-to-date result clearly.
guards: Guards against rewriting a branch that is already current, such as rebase --force or a reset, just to look busy.

prompt: origin/main에 리베이스해줘. 충돌은 생성된 lockfile뿐이고 package manifest의 의도는 명확해.
expectations: It derives the lockfile result from the authoritative manifest rather than guessing.
It completes the rebase when the intended result is provable.
It verifies that local work remains represented.

prompt: main을 당겨줘. 결제 정책 코드에서 양쪽 브랜치가 서로 다른 수수료 규칙을 추가해서 충돌해.
expectations: It recognizes that the conflict requires product intent.
It keeps the original work recoverable.
It reports the conflicting files and asks only for the policy decision needed to continue.

prompt: detached worktree의 현재 커밋을 최신 main 기준으로 맞춰줘. 로컬 커밋은 잃으면 안 돼.
expectations: It recognizes the detached checkout.
It preserves a recoverable reference to the local commits.
It reaches a state based on fetched origin/main without losing work.

prompt: 이 저장소의 remote default branch는 origin/trunk야. 브랜치 이름을 따로 지정하지 않았으니 기본 브랜치 최신 변경에 맞춰줘.
expectations: It resolves the remote default branch rather than assuming main.
It fetches and rebases onto origin/trunk.
It reports the resolved remote and base branch.
guards: Guards against falling back to main when the user named another base.

source: session: flyn fly-109 pull after a dirty check
expectations: It inspects the working tree and identifies the uncommitted change to src/search.js and the untracked docs/search-ideas.md before rewriting history.
It does not commit, stash (including rebase --autostash), or discard those changes without the user's authority.
It leaves the local state intact and tells the user that the uncommitted work blocks a safe update, naming the files.

prompt: main 당겨서 내 브랜치 최신화해 줘.
expectations: It recognizes that the conflict in src/shipping.js sets the free-shipping threshold to two different amounts (30,000 vs 50,000 won), a product decision rather than a mechanical merge.
It does not pick either threshold or invent a third: it leaves the branch recoverable, either stopped in the rebase or aborted back to the original commit.
It reports the conflicting file and asks only which threshold should apply.
guards: Guards against picking one side of a product-rule conflict and finishing the rebase.

source: session: nexus pull with a prose conflict resolved by picking one side
expectations: It recognizes that both sides rewrote the same opening paragraph of docs/eval-guide.md with different examples (refund routing vs double charge), so which text to keep is an authoring decision.
It does not silently keep one side, drop the other, or write a merged paragraph of its own: it leaves the branch recoverable, either stopped in the rebase or aborted back to the original commit.
It reports the conflicting file and asks which opening to keep, or how to combine them.

source: session: turbo-repo-template pull with a decision index conflict
expectations: It recognizes that the conflict in docs/decisions/README.md is two independent index entries added at the same place (cache and monospace).
It resolves the conflict by keeping both entries and completes the rebase onto the fetched origin/main.
It reports the resolved base and how the conflict was resolved, and verifies the local decision file and both entries survived.
guards: Guards against the skill pushing "ask when intent is ambiguous" too far: a mechanical conflict should be resolved, not handed back.

source: variant of evals.json #4; merge sessions where a refactor collided with a value change
prompt: main 위로 리베이스해 줘. 내 브랜치는 요청 타임아웃을 60초로 올리는 커밋 하나야.
expectations: It reads both sides of the conflict in src/http.js and the incoming commit's message, and sees that main only named the default timeout without changing behavior.
It resolves the conflict so the result keeps main's named constant structure and the local 60-second timeout, then completes the rebase.
It checks the resolved timeout value and reports the resolved base and incoming commit.
guards: Guards against the skill pushing "ask when intent is ambiguous" too far, and against keeping the refactor while losing the 60-second value.

source: session: claude-code-playbook worktrees updated while detached
prompt: 이 worktree를 최신 main 기준으로 올려 줘.
expectations: It notices that the checkout is on a detached HEAD carrying a local commit that no branch holds.
It preserves a recoverable reference to that local commit (for example a branch or tag at the original commit, or by naming the original commit hash in its report) before or while rewriting it.
It ends on a state based on the fetched origin/main that still contains the local points change.

source: variant of evals.json #7; sessions resolving the default with remote show origin
prompt: 내 브랜치를 기본 브랜치 최신 상태 위로 올려 줘.
expectations: It resolves the remote's advertised default branch (develop) from the remote rather than assuming main.
It fetches and rebases onto origin/develop, not onto origin/main.
It reports the resolved remote and base branch and the commits that arrived.

source: session: nexus pull on main with an unpushed local commit
expectations: It fetches origin and sees that local main has one unpushed commit while origin/main gained two.
It rebases the local commit onto origin/main rather than creating a merge commit (no plain git pull that merges).
It reports the incoming commits and that the local commit now sits on top of origin/main.
guards: Guards against a plain git pull that leaves a merge commit on main.
